data.name: Esam
data.gender_notes: Esam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Esam means 'given by God'. It is derived from the Arabic root 's-m-m', which signifies 'given' or 'bestowed'. This beautiful name is mentioned in the Quran, where Prophet Ibrahim (AS) is described as having given his son Ismail (AS) the name Esam (Ibrahim: 37:101). The name Esam carries the meaning “Given by God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Esam usually hope their child will grow to embody given by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Esam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Given by God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Esam total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إسم
in_arabic.meaning: أسم يعني اسمًا يُطلق على الشخص

in_urdu.name: اسم
in_urdu.meaning: اسم جسمانی کہتے ہیں جن پر نام پڑتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسم کا مطلب ہے جسمانی کہتے ہیں جن پر نام پڑتا ہے، جو کہ عربي جڑوں سے تعلق رکھتا ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے فضل اور جلالت کا نام، جو کہ اسلام میں ایک مقدس نام ہے جو کسی کے لئے نامزد کیا جاتا ہے، اور جو کہ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایت میں ثقافتی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، اور اس کے معنی ہیں فضل اور جلالت کی علامت
